headlines.text: On this day in 2024, a new champion was crowned for the AEW International Title as MJF vs. Will Ospreay battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.40 ? a fantastic contest ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In a grueling nearly 60-minute battle, MJF shoved Ospreay into referee Bryce Remsburg before landing an unseen ring-shot with his Dynamite Diamond Ring to dethrone Ospreay for the International Title.
It was 2024 when Swerve Strickland vs. Kazuchika Okada closed out Dynamite, rated 5.65 in a hard-fought men's division clash.
Back on this day in 2024, Mercedes Mone vs. Nyla Rose clashed for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.61. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
